Key information:

We invite you to participate in the following survey. The results of these studies are for research purposes and de-identified data may be shared with other researchers or used for future research. 



Purpose:

This research (Columbia IRB #: AAAV0918) examines everyday feelings and behaviors. 



Procedures: 

You will be asked to engage in a brief activity and answer questions about yourself. Your participation will take approximately 6 minutes. 



Voluntariness: 

This study is completely voluntary. You can withdraw from this study at any time by closing your Internet browser window. You may not skip questions unless otherwise noted. 



Confidentiality: 

We do not ask for your name or any other information that might identify you. Although collected data may be made public or used for future research purposes, your identity will always remain confidential. In addition to the research investigators on this project, authorities from Columbia University, including the IRB (i.e., committee organized to protect the rights and welfare of people involved in research), and the federal Office of  Human Research Protections may obtain access to data collected for this study. However, this data cannot and will not be traced back to you. 



Risks and benefits: 

We do not anticipate any risks to participants. There are no benefits to participation. 



Compensation: 

You will be compensated $1.20 for your time. Additional bonuses are possible. 

To receive payment, you must submit the completion code that you will receive at the end of the 

survey. 



Your questions: 

If you have any questions about the research, please contact me the researchers at sm4409@gsb.columbia.edu or sjg2222@columbia.edu. We recommend that you write down the researchers’ contact information. If you have questions about your rights as a research subject, contact Columbia’s Campus Institutional Review Board at askirb@columbia.edu or at 212-305-5883.
